messages:
Emily (Infra PM): @here rolling out a soft-open for new Dedicated 'L6e-compact' micro-pools in eu-west-1 (Dublin) and sa-east-1 (Santiago). These are low-power L6e variants optimized for steady throughput workloads. :tada:
Praveen (Capacity): Allocation details: 10 micro-pools in Dublin, 6 in Santiago. Soft-open means limited reservations and pay-as-you-go burst until next week. Please don't create long-lived reserved commitments yet.
CapacityBot: NOTE automated: initial capacity will be available for 48h soft-open window starting now. Billing will reflect on next invoice.
Marco (SRE): Ops note: these micro-pools are preemptible by higher-tier pools under pressure. We'll have a 30m preemption window with a 5m graceful drain. Put critical batch jobs on Dedicated reserved pools instead.
Sara (Finance): Quick question — how will usage show up on invoices? burst charges vs reserved?
Emily (Infra PM): Sara: burst usage will be billed at the new L6e-compact on-demand rate (see /billing/pricing-dedicated). Reservations are not enabled for these micro-pools during the soft-open. We'll publish a migration path to reserved SKU next week.
Praveen (Capacity): Reservation limits during soft-open: max 4 concurrent reservations per org per-region, 2 per-team tag. We want to avoid hoarding while we validate perf. If you need more for a critical customer, ping me directly.
ops-oncall: tagging ops for awareness @ops — we'll monitor eviction spikes and ramp down if tail latencies grow.
Marco (SRE): Quick operational checklist for teams using L6e-compact: please set graceful termination handler in your job templates and avoid >8k token contexts in one-shot runs to keep KV cache healthy.
Sara (Finance): thanks — can you post the cost-per-hour somewhere? need to update customer estimates.
Praveen (Capacity): Posted rate: 0.18 USD/GPU-hr (soft-open promotional). Final reserved price TBD.
Emily (Infra PM): For engineers: sample reservation CLI (soft-open, limited):
```
# reserve a compact micro-pool for testing
redwood reserve create --pool l6e-compact --region eu-west-1 --duration 2h --tags team=search
```
Praveen (Capacity): If you hit quota errors, increase retry backoff and add a 60s jitter. We'll surface quota adjustments if it's a validated customer need.
Marco (SRE): I'll open a dashboard: /console/dedicated/l6e-compact -> monitors for preemptions, avg latency, and token throughput. Ops will alert at 5% preemption or 200ms p50 delta vs baseline.
Emily (Infra PM): Timeline: soft-open now -> feedback window 72h -> wider soft-launch with reservation SKU on Monday 09:00 UTC if no major regressions. Please file issues in #eng-runtime if you see correctness regressions.
CapacityBot: REMINDER automated: collect perf samples with /tools/collector on first 10k requests for each customer traffic pattern.
Sara (Finance): noted. Also flagging that promo rate requires budget approval for customer-facing pricing. Looping in finance owners.
Praveen (Capacity): Thanks all. If you need to test cross-region fallback, note that L6e-compact has slightly different kernel selection; fallback targets to L6e-standard in case of incompatibility. Mention me in the thread for expedited support. :thumbsup:
